name: LibreY
description: A fork of LibreX, a framework- and JavaScript-free privacy respecting meta search engine, giving you results from Google, Qwant, Ahmia and popular torrent sites without spying on you. LibreY changed some features like automatic redirection. See documentation for all available settings: https://github.com/Ahwxorg/LibreY/tree/main/docker#environment-variables-that-can-be-set-in-the-docker-container

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Language to perform searches in

variables.name: Text Search Engine
variables.description: Text search engine to use. Set 'auto' to use any available search engine.

variables.name: Default Number of Results
variables.description: Number of results to show by default

variables.name: Site Name
variables.description: Site name to show in search results

variables.name: OPEN_SEARCH_LONG_NAME
variables.description: Site long name to show in search results

variables.name: Site Description
variables.value: Framework and javascript free privacy respecting meta search engine
variables.description: Site description to show in search results

variables.name: Site Host
variables.description: Site host to identify on network. Replace with IP or domain.

variables.name: Google - Domain
variables.description: Which Google domain the search will be done on. Change according to your country.

variables.name: Invidious Instance
variables.description: Invidious instance to use for YouTube videos

variables.name: Disable BitTorrent Search
variables.description: Disable BitTorrent search

variables.name: BitTorrent Trackers
variables.description: List of bittorrent trackers for torrent search. See documentation: https://github.com/Ahwxorg/LibreY/tree/main/docker#environment-variables-that-can-be-set-in-the-docker-container

variables.name: Enable Hidden Service Search
variables.description: Enable hidden service search

variables.name: Show Result Source
variables.description: Whether to show where the result is from on the results page

variables.name: Instance Fallback
variables.description: Fallback to another instance if the current one is rate-limited

variables.name: Disable API
variables.description: Disable the API

variables.name: Theme
variables.description: Default theme to use

variables.name: Rate-Limit Cooldown
variables.description: Cooldown time, in minutes, for rate limiting

variables.name: Cache Time
variables.description: Time, in minutes, to cache results for

variables.name: Search Encoding
variables.description: Encoding to use for search results

variables.name: PHP - Proxy Enabled
variables.description: Enable PHP proxy. See documentation: https://github.com/Ahwxorg/LibreY/tree/main/docker#curl

variables.name: PHP - Proxy Host
variables.description: PHP proxy host

variables.name: PHP - Proxy Type
variables.description: PHP proxy type

variables.name: PHP - Proxy User-Agent
variables.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:116.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/116.0
variables.description: PHP proxy user agent

variables.name: PHP - Follow Location
variables.description: PHP follow location

variables.name: Google - Site Language
variables.description: Language to use for Google site

variables.name: Google - Results Language
variables.description: Language to use for Google results

variables.name: Wikipedia - Language
variables.description: Language to use for Wikipedia

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Tell application it is running as a Docker container. Not recommended to change.
